workout.session_type: Lower Body - STRENGTH BLOCK Day 15 (HINGE RESET)
workout.warmup: NON-NEGOTIABLE TODAY: 10 min incline walk (3.3-3.5 mph, 6-8%). Then Bird Dog x 8/side, bodyweight Glute Bridge x 15, 90/90 hip switches x 10/side. Ramp the squat: bar + 45/side x 8, then 70/side x 3.
workout.coach_note: This is the session where we fix your back. Three lower days in a row have ended with a tight or fried lower back - Jul 30 (skipped core, body fried), Aug 3 (RDL set 4 and hip thrusts, back tired), Aug 8 (tight from the FIRST movement and it never let go). That is not bad luck, that is the heavy bilateral hinge. The Smith RDL went 205 to 235 in a single session on Aug 3, and your hotel DB RDL at 65 lb unstrapped on Aug 8 is the exact lift and load that strained your upper back on June 9. So the RDL is OUT this week. It gets replaced with the 45-degree back extension: same hamstring and glute hinge pattern, torso supported on a pad, zero spinal compression, no grip or forearm limiter. Everything else stays heavy. The squat still progresses to 215. You are not deloading, you are removing the one lift that keeps writing checks your low back has to cash. Also worth naming: Monday you pressed 55 for 8/8/8/10 and beat the prescription while under-recovered and hungover. The lift-order change is permanent and it is working.
workout.finisher: 10-12 min incline walk. Do not skip this one - it flushes the lower back.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat [HEAVY]
exercises.detail: 215 lb (95 per side + 25 lb bar) - 4 x 6
exercises.note: Clean 4x6 at 205 on Aug 3, so 215 is earned. The squat is NOT what is irritating your back - it is back-supported and you have handled every jump in this block. Brace hard before you unrack, chest up, controlled down, drive through midfoot. STOP RULE: if your low back is tight during the ramp sets or set 1, drop to 205 for all four sets and tell me. No hero sets today, we are protecting the fix.

exercises.name: 45-Degree Back Extension - REPLACES RDL
exercises.detail: Bodyweight x 12, then hold a 25 lb plate at the chest - 3 x 12
exercises.note: THIS IS THE HINGE CHANGE. Pad at the hip crease, NOT up at your belly button - if the pad is too high you hinge from the spine instead of the hips. Squeeze glutes and hamstrings to come up, stop when your body is a straight line - do NOT arch past neutral at the top. Slow 3-second lower. First set bodyweight to find the groove, then hold the 25 lb plate. No 45-degree bench at your gym? Sub Seated Good Morning with a light bar (65 lb) 3 x 12, or add a 4th set to the leg curl. Report which you did.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust Machine
exercises.note: Hold at 200, do not chase weight here. On Aug 3 you ran these on the Smith at 90/side AFTER the RDLs and your back and glutes were cooked by set 2. Today they follow a spine-friendly hinge, so all three sets should be there. Full hip extension, hard glute squeeze, ribs down, chin tucked - ZERO hyperextension at the top. No machine? Smith at 65-70 per side with a pad, and stop at 3 sets regardless.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Third time asking for 12/12/12 at 70. Jul 30 you got 12/10/10, Aug 3 you got 12/10/12 - set 2 is where you leak. Take the full 90 seconds before set 2 and drive it. Get all 36 clean and you move to 80 next lower day. Hamstrings are your weak link and they are also your lower back's best friend, so this one matters more than usual right now.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: Reps cut from 10 to 8 per leg so you can actually own 35 lb. Aug 8 you got two sets at 35 and dropped to 30 for the third, but that was a hotel session on a tight back after a 4.5 hour car ride. Torso tall, knee tracks over the toe, drive through the front heel. Three clean sets of 8 at 35 and we go back to 10s next time.

exercises.name: Core Circuit - BACK-SAFE RESET
exercises.detail: 2 rounds: Dead Bugs x 10/side, Side Plank 45 sec/side, Bird Dog x 8/side
exercises.note: Every movement here is anti-extension or anti-rotation - exactly what an irritated low back needs, and nothing loads the spine. Lower back pressed flat on the dead bugs, hips stacked on the side plank, one-second pause at the top of every bird dog. Do NOT skip this like you did on Jul 30 - right now this circuit is treatment, not accessory work.
